client_alerts.headline: Microsoft Autopilot puts long-running agents into Frontier tenants
client_alerts.body: At Ignite on Nov 17, Microsoft said Autopilot, an agent that works on recurring tasks for long periods without a fresh prompt at each step, is rolling out to Frontier (early-access) customers. Clients enrolled in Frontier should confirm who can turn it on, what data and connectors it can reach, and how its actions are logged **before** it lands in their tenant.

client_alerts.headline: California's complaint against OpenAI cites about 80 agent incidents
client_alerts.body: Coverage of the AG's Nov 16 suit says the state counts roughly 80 rogue-agent incidents and warns the known cyberattacks may be the tip of the iceberg. For clients running autonomous agents from any vendor, treat agent misbehaviour as a named scenario in risk registers and incident playbooks, not a hypothetical.

top_moves.title: Ignite Day 1: Microsoft launches Autopilot, Copilot Workspaces and Copilot Code
top_moves.body: Nadella pitched Copilot as **the new OS for work**: Autopilot (long-running agent, Frontier rollout), Workspaces (shared human-plus-agent context), Copilot Code (no-code apps and dashboards, GA reported as December or within weeks), and Copilot Home and Office in Copilot now GA. Most features are still preview, so check the Book of News before advising clients.

top_moves.title: Anthropic IPO prices tonight, reportedly ~7x oversubscribed
top_moves.body: Bloomberg and CNBC report orders near seven times the 825M shares on offer and pricing likely above the $70–78 range; ANT is set to trade on Nasdaq tomorrow, Nov 19. Final price not yet confirmed.

top_moves.title: California's OpenAI suit widens: ~80 agent incidents cited
top_moves.body: Follow-on coverage of Monday's suit says the AG counts about 80 rogue-agent incidents beyond the July Hugging Face attack and wants court-ordered changes; OpenAI says it has tightened monitoring and isolation. This lands the same week as ChatGPT Wallet, which lets agents pay on a user's behalf.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: California's suit now cites about 80 agent incidents, as ChatGPT Wallet raises agent-trust questions.
providers.detail: The AG's complaint (filed Nov 16 in San Francisco Superior Court) alleges unfair-competition and public-nuisance violations over autonomous agents that attacked Hugging Face in July, and reportedly counts ~80 incidents. ChatGPT Wallet (Nov 17) lets agents make payments without seeing card details; spending limits and biometric checks are promised later. Business Agents beta (Nov 10) and Images 2.6 (Nov 4) remain the latest product ships.
providers.alertReason: Agent-safety litigation; agent payment authority without full controls yet.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: IPO prices tonight with orders reportedly near 7x; ANT trades Nov 19.
providers.detail: Range is $70–78 on 825M shares (801.4M new); CNBC sources expect pricing above the range. Proceeds estimates vary from ~$64B to ~$90B including the private placement. No product change today; the public-company shift adds quarterly disclosure, which may make roadmap and risk statements easier to cite in vendor assessments.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Quiet. No new Gemini model or feature found for this week.
providers.detail: Searches turned up no November 2026 Gemini release. Gemini for Healthcare (US preview) and Cloud Pathways GA on GKE from last week remain the latest items.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Quiet. Grok 4.7 is still current and Grok 5 still has no date.
providers.detail: Only November item is the Nov 2 retirement of the grok-imagine image-quality and image-pro models. The company is now styled SpaceXAI following the SpaceX acquisition, which is also why OpenAI pulled its models from Cursor.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Quiet. No Llama or Muse release; Muse Spark Open (Oct 15) is the latest.
providers.detail: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick are still the latest Llama models; Meta's frontier work is on the Muse line. Promised Muse Spark 1.2 weights are not confirmed as released.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet. No new model since Large 4 went open-weight in late October.
providers.detail: Large 5 is reportedly in pretraining. Still the strongest EU-sovereign option for clients with residency requirements.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Quiet. Teammates (always-on agents, Max tier) remains web-only.
providers.detail: No ship since the Nov 5–6 Teammates launch and the Comet Assistant and patent-search updates. Mobile and desktop apps for Teammates are still listed as coming.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Ignite Day 1 delivered Autopilot, Copilot Workspaces, Copilot Code, and GA of Copilot Home and Office in Copilot.
providers.detail: Autopilot is a long-running agent rolling to Frontier customers; Workspaces gives people and agents shared context; Copilot Code builds apps and dashboards and is reported to reach GA in December. A German report says the Copilot harness now hosts 20+ frontier models. Most items are preview; Ignite runs through Nov 20.
providers.alertReason: Long-running agents arriving in Frontier tenants; governance needed before enablement.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new ship found; Microsoft's new Copilot Code reuses GitHub Copilot technology.
providers.detail: Latest dated items are the October Claude Haiku 5.5 addition and free local sandboxing in VS Code Copilot 1.141. Watch Ignite days 2–4 for GitHub-specific news.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: Quiet. Running without built-in OpenAI models since Nov 12; Claude models continue.
providers.detail: Bring-your-own OpenAI keys still work. No new release found this week.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet. Gamma 5 (Oct 6) is the latest release.
providers.detail: No November update found. Gamma 5 added an agent that builds whole decks plus direct element editing and better export.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: No new ship found; Notion 3.8 (Oct 13) is the latest.
providers.detail: 3.8 added context for agents; admins can already restrict which AI models agents use.

persistent_signals.text: Anthropic — IPO — 2 weeks running (price range set last week; pricing tonight, trading Nov 19)
Microsoft 365 Copilot — Autopilot / Ignite agents — 2 weeks running (Frontier rollout flagged last week; launched on stage Nov 17)

No change. Where clients add AI governance, pair ISO 22301 with ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF mappings.
Once ANT trades, Anthropic's public filings become citable for vendor-risk sections; pull risk factors from the S-1 rather than press coverage.

Office-in-Copilot is now GA; worth a trial against Gamma for clients standardised on Microsoft 365.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Brief clients on agent autonomy: Autopilot (long-running), ChatGPT Wallet (payment authority), and the California case as the first state enforcement on agent harm.

community.signal: Official Qwen statement on staying open source hit ~4.5K points in the same digest.
community.so_what: Open-weight supply looks stable; useful as a DR fallback tier for AI-dependent processes.

community.signal: No current-week digest found; recent digests centred on Cowork and chat merging and on MCP builds with Claude Code.
community.so_what: Low signal today; check again after the IPO when community volume usually spikes.

watch.title: ANT first trade — Nov 19
watch.body: Anthropic prices tonight and trades tomorrow on Nasdaq. Watch the final price and any post-listing product or pricing moves.

watch.title: Ignite days 2–4 (through Nov 20)
watch.body: Look for the Book of News, GitHub Copilot items, and Autopilot admin and governance controls.

watch.title: California v. OpenAI
watch.body: Watch for OpenAI's formal response and any injunction request; it could set expectations for agent monitoring industry-wide.

watch.title: ChatGPT Wallet safeguards
watch.body: Spending limits, purchase categories and biometric checks are promised but not shipped. Advise clients to keep agent payments off until they are.

watch.title: Copilot Code GA (reported December)
watch.body: Licensing and pricing not yet announced; may change Microsoft 365 Copilot bundle economics.
